title: kengyilia kokonorica
intro: Kengyilia kokonorica, commonly known as the Kokonor wheat grass, is a type of plant species in the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Kengyilia kokonorica include relieving fever, soothing digestive issues, and aiding in respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
